notablePrerequisites: Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Omen Hawker triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.
